links.outcome: Segmentation IoU under adversarial perturbation, before and after multi-attack adversarial defense
links.effect: Undefended UNet++ IoU collapsed 23.5% (0.851 to 0.649) under perturbation; adversarial defense raised IoU by 14.9% (0.649 to 0.798) at one epsilon and 12.5% at another.
links.quote: Our results reveal that even minimal perturbations caused large performance drops, such as at [Formula: see text], IoU collapsed to 23.5% (0.851 to 0.649).

unlisted_practices: Adversarial training with multi-attack defense to improve robustness of segmentation models

screen.reason: The study directly tests and evaluates the impact of an adversarial training/defense strategy to enhance the safety and robustness of deep learning segmentation models against adversarial attacks.
